purpose: Identify and separate explicit banner occurrence, CardPool, Hero, wish-selection, CP, and event relation shapes without creating the final production schema or using name-based joins.

coreDecision.principle: Resolve relations from explicit IDs or explicit source semantics. Do not collapse display names, asset codes, CardPool identity, Hero identity, CP context, or event labels into one inferred relation.

rules: Manual Korean occurrence rows may legitimately have null sourceRecordKey.
A CardPool source may be reused by multiple dated Korean occurrences.
sourceRecordKey is a source relation, not the final website bannerId.
Apply verified relation-correction checkpoints before later consumer generation.

cardPoolToPickupHero.sourceSemantics: CardPool detail text identifies the featured probability-up heroes while UpHeroList stores their explicit Hero IDs.

fieldFamilies.meaning: Explicit selectable/candidate Hero list used by optional/return/reminiscence and related wish structures.

Explicit Hero candidate list used by other wish structures such as 新晋·许愿召唤 and rotating/team wish variants. Preserve this source field separately even if a later normalized consumer chooses a common relation type.

cardPoolToWishCandidateHero.joinRule: Use HeroId only; preserve JobConnectionId as source metadata and do not use it as Hero identity.
cardPoolToWishCandidateHero.manualOccurrencePolicy: If a Korean manual wish occurrence has no CardPool source and only selectableText/display names, do not synthesize Hero edges. Keep the selectable relation in REVIEW until an explicit ID-bearing source or approved manual ID map exists.
cardPoolToWishCandidateHero.importantBoundary: WISH_CANDIDATE_HERO is not PICKUP_HERO and must not be inferred as DUAL simply because two heroes may eventually be selected.

cardPoolToCpContext.evidenceRule: Assign CP_RELATED only when the CardPool source text explicitly states that drawing an SSR also grants CP points usable in a named event.
cardPoolToCpContext.mechanicDecision: CP_RELATED is a non-exclusive context relation/tag on a pickup CardPool/occurrence, not a mutually exclusive top-level summon mechanic.
cardPoolToCpContext.prohibitedInference: Do not assign CP_RELATED from Hero pairing, bannerCode, asset code, or Korean terminology alone.

cpContextToEvent.observedShape: A CP CardPool description can explicitly name the event in which CP points are usable.
cpContextToEvent.joinPolicy: Do not join event records by display-name equality. Preserve the CardPool event label as text evidence until an explicit event ID relation or separately verified mapping is established.
cpContextToEvent.productRequirementImpact: The banner+event page is supported as a product requirement, but its canonical event JOIN is not yet proven by current banner sources.

displayAndPreviewFields.rule: Preserve for display/provenance as applicable, but do not substitute these fields for UpHeroList or wish-candidate fields when defining pickup/selectable Hero relations.
